name: Interactive LINE Task Control
requiresDatabases: Project-local Tasks data source with task-control fields

dataIsolation.guard: Every query and write uses the resolved tenant Tasks data source and rejects a task whose Group Binding relation is not the current LINE group's binding.

definitionOfDone: Shared LINE postback and task-control module pass dry-run verification
Target tenant receives additive Tasks fields only in its own data source
Today, week, completed, and keyword/task-text search cards are available from LINE
Bound one-to-one Rich Menu commands return the same interactive task cards with owner and active-group scope checks
Slow direct identity or task queries return an explicit retry message instead of remaining silent
Completion and progress/next-step/blocker/keyword updates append auditable LINE evidence
Target tenant manifest and upgrade record are updated after local verification
